label: Vals AI · Vals Index v2.2 (finance, coding, legal, tax agent tasks)
note: ANCHOR for analysis and data. A GDP-weighted average of Finance Agent v2.1 + Excel Modeling (finance), Terminal-Bench 4.0 + Vibe Code + Code Migration (coding), Legal Research + HLAB (legal) and Tax Agent Bench: real multi-step knowledge work with tools, which is what a Cascade section actually asks of a model. One harness for every model. Band 0..73: the top (~71%) reads ~97. Only rates the current generation. Open and other providers' current versions are captured too (Kimi, GLM, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax, Mistral Large 4, MiMo), so a model reached through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint is routed on its own scores. Where a board lists a model both undated and as a dated snapshot (DeepSeek V4 / V4 Pro 0813, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / 1017, Qwen 3.8 Max / 0902), the newest dated snapshot is used: it is what the provider's alias serves. Only the board's own harness counts (Mini-SWE-agent or Terminus 2), never a vendor harness row such as Claude Code, Codex or Factory.
